# Final Project

The final project has two parts: replication and extension.

## Deliverables

- A cleaned data file or a reproducible script that creates it.
- A replication table and event-study figure.
- A one-page comparison to Walker et al. [-@walker2023anticipatory].
- An extension table or figure using The Pregnant Scholar policy directory or a literal Title IX religious-exemption dataset.
- An AI use log.

## Grading guide

Strong projects:

- Make the sample construction visible.
- Keep raw and cleaned data separate.
- Explain why 2021 is the reference year.
- Treat source limitations honestly.
- Use AI in a documented and checkable way.
- Distinguish replication from extension.

Weak projects usually fail because they hide the data collection decisions. In this assignment, those decisions are the work.
